# Alex Pearwin

> > Personal site of Alex Pearwin, software engineer and former CERN physicist, featuring technical writing, projects, and curated resources.

This site serves as the professional homepage for Alex Pearwin, documenting his work in software engineering, particle physics research at CERN's LHCb experiment, and various technical projects including ImaginePay (medical billing platform) and Imaginis (women's health network). The site also aggregates curated content from TV Guide and Know Your Meme.

## Key Topics

- Particle Physics

- ImaginePay
- Imaginis

## About

## Projects & Products

- [ImaginePay](https://imaginepay.com): ImaginePay medical payment platform homepage - HIPAA/PCI compliant billing
- [HOW IT WORKS](https://imaginepay.com/how-it-works): 5-step payment process guide for ImaginePay medical billing system
- [ImaginePay PATIENT PORTALS - Assured Imaging](https://assuredimaging.com/imaginepay): Assured Imaging patient payment portals powered by ImaginePay
- [Imaginis - The Women's Health & Wellness Resource Network](https://imaginis.com): Women's health resource network covering breast cancer, cervical cancer, stroke
- [Imaginis Inc](https://imaginisinc.com): B2B marketing consultancy for brand awareness & lead generation
- [Imaginis Management Team](https://healththeater.imaginis.com/about/imaginis-management-team): Leadership team page for Imaginis women's health resource network

## Technical Writing

- [Moving from Jekyll to Eleventy](https://alex.pearwin.com/2020/06/jekyll-to-eleventy): Migration guide from Ruby-based Jekyll to JavaScript-based Eleventy SSG
- [Flask with Apache and Shibboleth authentication](https://alex.pearwin.com/2014/10/setting-up-flask-with-apache-and-shibboleth): Flask deployment tutorial with Apache WSGI & CERN Shibboleth SSO (archived)
- [An Ubuntu VPS with rbenv, nginx and Passenger](https://alex.pearwin.com/2012/06/setting-up-a-vps): Ubuntu VPS setup guide with rbenv, nginx, Passenger & PostgreSQL (archived)
- [Simpler Jekyll searching](https://alex.pearwin.com/2016/02/simpler-jekyll-searching): Simplified Jekyll 3 search implementation using YAML & client-side JS
